system.description: After using Sense the Sin on the target, the Baali spends a Willpower Trait, forcing the victim to make a Virtue Test against her weakest Virtue at a difficulty equal to the Traits risked in Sense the Sin. Failure conjures a nightmare apparition from the victim's past, visible only to her; she must make a Courage Test or frenzy, and must then contend with the construct as a physical threat (damage is illusory but can cause unconsciousness or torpor). The spectre vanishes if the Baali stops concentrating.
